title: Disease Notification Rates
text:
This website presents interactive disease notification-rate maps by Australian local government area (LGA).
Select a disease from the panel on the left to open its interactive map. Where multiple years are available, use the year selector in the upper-right corner of the map to switch between them.
Use the mouse, trackpad or map controls to zoom and pan. Hover over an LGA to view its notification rate and other available information.

title: Disease Notification Rates
text:
Data interpretation
(Dummy text) Notification rates are presented per 100,000 population. Rates based on small notification counts should be interpreted with appropriate caution.
(Dummy text) LGAs shaded grey do not have an available notification rate for the selected year.
